title: Address preservation under a selected flip
statement: For every natural number $m$ and every sign vector $x$ of length $m+2^m$, flipping the coordinate indexed by the address encoded by the first component of the decomposition of $x$ leaves that first component unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is a sign vector of length $m+2^m$
